name: Customer Sync Pipeline
description: Syncs customer records from Salesforce into the Customer entity. Runs every 2 hours via the Salesforce CRM connector schedule. Normalizes Salesforce Account fields to the Customer ontology schema.

steps.name: Map Account to Customer
steps.expression: records.map(r => ({ sourceId: r.sourceId, data: { customerId: r.data.Id, companyName: r.data.Name, contactEmail: r.data.Email || '', phone: r.data.Phone || null, industry: r.data.Industry || null, annualRevenue: Number(r.data.AnnualRevenue) || null, status: 'active', createdAt: r.data.CreatedDate, updatedAt: r.data.LastModifiedDate } }))

name: Order ETL Pipeline
description: Nightly ETL pipeline that extracts order data from the PostgreSQL warehouse, enriches it with customer information, and loads it into the Order entity store. Joins order records with customer IDs for relational integrity.

steps.name: Normalize Order Fields
steps.expression: records.map(r => ({ sourceId: r.sourceId, data: { orderId: r.data.order_number || r.sourceId, customerId: r.data.customer_account_id, totalAmount: Number(r.data.total_amount_cents) / 100, currency: r.data.currency_code || 'USD', status: r.data.fulfillment_status || 'pending', itemCount: Number(r.data.line_item_count) || 0, shippingAddress: [r.data.ship_street, r.data.ship_city, r.data.ship_state, r.data.ship_zip, r.data.ship_country].filter(Boolean).join(', '), orderedAt: r.data.created_at, updatedAt: r.data.updated_at } }))

name: Stripe Event Processor
description: Real-time event processing pipeline for Stripe webhooks. Receives payment events, classifies them by type, and writes structured records into the Event entity store for analytics and alerting.

steps.name: Classify and Normalize Event
steps.expression: records.map(r => { const evt = r.data; const eventType = evt.type.includes('refund') ? 'refund' : evt.type.includes('succeeded') ? 'purchase' : evt.type.includes('failed') ? 'payment_failed' : evt.type.includes('subscription') ? 'subscription_change' : 'other'; return { sourceId: evt.id, data: { eventId: evt.id, eventType: eventType, customerId: evt.data?.object?.customer || null, sessionId: evt.request?.idempotency_key || evt.id, properties: JSON.stringify({ stripeEventType: evt.type, amount: evt.data?.object?.amount, currency: evt.data?.object?.currency, paymentMethodType: evt.data?.object?.payment_method_types?.[0] }), source: 'webhook', occurredAt: new Date(evt.created * 1000).toISOString() } }; })
